passages.note: Senate Roll Call 58 on SB 1(ss) (Abortion); Koch voted Yea, 28-19.

passages.provision_quote: Abortion shall in all instances be a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances:
passages.note: Enrolled Act text: abortion is a criminal act except for serious health risk/life of the mother, a lethal fetal anomaly, or (within ten weeks) rape or incest.

rows.reasoning: Koch voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill; its enrolled text makes abortion 'a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances,' allowing it only for a serious risk to the mother's life/health, a lethal fetal anomaly, or, within ten weeks, when 'the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.' This matches rung 4's 'ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life' and excludes rung 5 (no exceptions) and rung 3 (broader first-trimester allowance).
